# Vendored: punjab-characters (from the user, 2026-10-22)

The user's Three.js character kit (6 rigged archetypes, many outfits incl. non-Sikh communities, 30+ clips, face morphs).
Kept here as source only; the exported GLBs (dist-models/) are rebuilt with `tools/bake-characters.mjs` in the game repo
into `public/models/characters/`. Not compiled by the game's tsconfig/vite.
